subject: reasoning
question:
In the following figure series, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b1775eefb381f16021c52e3be4954e8b06556619da947ccf32e01ddd8a5463b.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: Zig-zag line change to a straight line and vice versa.

The change moves from the bottom line up to the top line in a specific order:

Box 1 to Box 2: The 1st (bottom) line changes. It was a straight line and becomes a zig-zag line.

Box 2 to Box 3: The 2nd line changes. It was a straight line and became a zig-zag line.

Box 3 to Box 4: The 3rd line changes. It was a zig-zag and became a straight line.

Box 4 to Box 5 (The Solution): The 4th line changes. It was a straight line and became a zig-zag line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45138733564eef7405af6efe8ddb7232957e6aa7cfd9031518bc13152af97f61.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
